name: Auto Republish Posts
author: stupidsimpleplugins

sections.description:
Bring new life — and new traffic — to your old content.

Auto Republish Posts automatically updates the publish date of existing posts so they jump back to the top of your blog and RSS feed like brand-new content. Perfect for boosting visibility, improving SEO freshness, and giving evergreen posts the attention they deserve — all without rewriting a thing.

If your website has great posts that slowly disappear into the archive, this plugin brings them back to life on autopilot.

✅ Increase traffic by resurfacing proven content
✅ Improve SEO freshness signals naturally
✅ Save hours — no manual updating required
✅ Works for blogs, news sites, evergreen content, tutorials, and more
✅ Choose categories or republish everything
✅ Oldest-first or random selection
✅ Runs on a schedule you control (days/weeks/months)
✅ One-click manual republish button
✅ Clean, simple, reliable — set it and forget it

What does it do?
This plugin picks an existing post and updates its publish date, pushing it back to the top of your homepage and feed. Readers think it’s brand-new — search engines see fresh activity — you get more traffic from content you already created.

Who is this for?
Bloggers, publishers, WooCommerce store owners, affiliate sites, niche content sites, writers — anyone with valuable content drifting into the archives.

Pro Version Adds:
Minutes & hours scheduling, advanced priority queues, category weighting, marked-post pools, cooldown control, and more automation options for high-volume or fast-moving sites.

Bring your old posts back to life — automatically.

Install now and get your content working for you again.

External Services

This plugin displays external links from third-party services. No automatic data transmission occurs.

Plugins for WP
The plugin includes links to plugins-for-wp.com for Pro version upgrade information and support.

Service: Plugins for WP
Website: https://www.plugins-for-wp.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.plugins-for-wp.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.plugins-for-wp.com/terms-and-conditions/

When External Connections Occur:

  • When user clicks “Pro Version” tab and clicks upgrade link (opens plugins-for-wp.com)
  • When user clicks “Support” tab and clicks support link (opens plugins-for-wp.com)

Data Transmitted:

  • No personal data or usage analytics transmitted
  • All connections are user-initiated

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or transmit visitor or user personal data.
It stores only site-admin configuration settings in WordPress options.

License

This program is free software under GPL-2.0-or-later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload
  2. Activate
  3. Open Auto Republish in WP admin menu
  4. Choose settings and save
sections.faq:
Does this duplicate posts?

No. It updates the publish date to recycle the post.

Does it work without a license key?

Yes. There is no license gate in the Lite version.
